mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_call_log (user_id, scene_id, model_id, conversation_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms, success, error_msg, call_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sceneId}, #{modelId}, #{conversationId}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{latencyMs}, #{success}, #{errorMsg}, #{callTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_call_log WHERE DATE(call_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_call_log WHERE DATE_FORMAT(call_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM ai_call_log WHERE DATE_FORMAT(call_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT DATE(call_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ai_call_log WHERE call_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(call_time) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT s.name AS scene_name, COUNT(l.id) AS call_count FROM ai_call_log l LEFT JOIN ai_scene s ON l.scene_id = s.id GROUP BY l.scene_id, s.name ORDER BY call_count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT m.model_name, COUNT(l.id) AS call_count FROM ai_call_log l LEFT JOIN ai_model_config m ON l.model_id = m.id GROUP BY l.model_id, m.model_name ORDER BY call_count DESC
SELECT DATE(call_time) AS date, SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens FROM ai_call_log WHERE call_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(call_time) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT u.real_name, u.username, COUNT(l.id) AS call_count FROM ai_call_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON l.user_id = u.id GROUP BY l.user_id, u.real_name, u.username ORDER BY call_count DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_call_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(call_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_call_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(call_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) FROM ai_call_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(call_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
